items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: So I'm going to go to the manager of the theater, so I sent for the manager to come back stage. So the manager sent the Assistant Manager back.

ctx.x: I figured it was a bad deal what we got out of it. They said don't mention it to anyone. After I thought it over for a few years. I couldn't think of that in the beginning. However, we didn't mention it to no one and later on I went to execute my position in getting work without Nazarro -- before I went to get work I had another mishap that happened at the B. F. Keith Theater in Boston, Massachusetts, where we were on the bill playing and we needed some money to pay our hotel bill that we didn't have a chance to…

the money and send it to them because we owe it to them. Okay? He says, he's not going to do it. So, I said, well, we've got to get the money. So I'm going to go to the manager of the theater, so I sent for the manager to come back stage. So the manager sent the Assistant Manager back. So when the Assistant Manager came back, he got the Assistant Manager before I saw him and told him what not to do where I was concerned. And I told him, look, the only way we can get this straightened out is for him to give us --…
You were still involved with Nazarro.
